node.label: Myocardial late gadolinium enhancement
node.definition: Areas of high signal intensity in magnetic resonance imaging of the heart appearing 10 to 15 minutes after injection of the intercellular contrast agent gadolinium.

evidence.snippet: Wild type ATTR amyloidosis: Myocardial late gadolinium enhancement (frequency HP:0040281) [TAS]
Myocardial late gadolinium enhancement — Very frequent (99-80%)
